name: Kairos
gloss: Power is what moves the world, and windows close. Act while the window is open.

name: Shi (勢)
gloss: Power is what moves the world, but you build position rather than force outcomes.

name: Nomos
gloss: Rules make cooperation durable, and rules that are not enforced are not rules.

name: Concert
gloss: Rules make cooperation durable, and the restraint of the strong is what sustains them.

name: Mandala
gloss: Legitimacy and status are causes, not decoration, and they can be actively contested.

name: Nemawashi (根回し)
gloss: Legitimacy and status are causes, and they are built slowly rather than declared.

name: Dirigisme
gloss: Production, finance and dependence structure politics, and the state should shape them.

name: Dependencia
gloss: Production, finance and dependence structure politics, and the first task is to reduce exposure.
